sourcePolicy: TradingView Top Stories, creator/social material and market-flow commentary are discovery inputs only. Material claims must survive primary/authoritative verification before changing scores or actions.

tradingViewTopStories.handling: Reviewed fresh TradingView News items surfaced for Sep 1 and used them to widen discovery. Did not assume the hash-based Top Stories module was complete when dynamic rendering/indexing was inconsistent. Current themes were independently cross-checked with Reuters, company IR, official market/price sources and the active macro stack.

currentMarketMap.read: The joint move in long yields and energy inflation is the immediate valuation/positioning gate for almost every risk asset.
US10Y around 4.76–4.78% and Japan 10Y near 3% increase the penalty on leverage, speculative duration and weak cash conversion.
Hormuz remains constrained and diesel/middle-distillate transmission is still a stronger inflation mechanism than crude alone.

currentMarketMap.theme: Americas crude + US LNG energy security
currentMarketMap.read: Supply diversification is becoming structural rather than merely a spot-war trade.
Orders/backlogs remain strong, but the higher cost of capital makes valuation and financing quality more important.
Nitrogen scarcity plus El Nino/India rainfall risk is becoming investable; food demand resilience does not remove farm-input demand elasticity.
The bond regime raises the penalty on convertibles, SPVs and capital-intensive AI infrastructure without current FCF.
CRM/CRWD operating evidence validates selective software winners, but large post-earnings gaps require pullback discipline.

notableScoreMoves.reason: Operating fuel-cycle quality and current support zone outweigh fading freshness of nuclear narrative.

Seed/genetics has high demand resilience and agriculture is phasing in.

Excellent demand but high AI-duration and valuation sensitivity under the bond selloff.

holdingsDecision: Every current holding was rescanned against the new theme map. Fundamental numeric scores remain unchanged because the current changes are macro/theme transmission rather than new company financial statements. Action text in latest-market-review.json was refreshed.
watchlistDecision: Reranked around both current opportunity and complementarity with the existing portfolio: CF, CTVA and BG gain from agriculture diversification; LNG is promoted by fresh energy-security significance but penalised for energy overlap/near-resistance; PWR/ETN remain elite but portfolio overlap and higher yields increase the entry hurdle.
